h1: AI UGC Ads for Electronics Products
lead: Make AI product videos for electronics from a gadget photo or product link. Show the device in use without waiting for a creator or camera day.
card: Unboxings, setups, and daily-use scenes from one gadget photo.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot to make an electronics ad?
faq.a: No. Upload a gadget photo or product link, choose one action, and download the clip. You see the credit cost first.

faq.q: Do I need editing skills to make the ad?
faq.a: No. Add a spoken line and captions, then edit them before you export the gadget clip.

faq.q: Can I make several ads from one gadget photo?
faq.a: Yes. Try an unboxing, a setup, and a desk demo from the same product image.
Speakers, chargers, headphones, cables, and small appliances work when your source photo clearly shows the item.

faq.q: Can I make the ad without hiring a creator?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI avatar and use the product photo or listing link as your starting point.

faq.q: Will the ad know my device specifications?
faq.a: Type battery life, wattage, and compatibility yourself. Check every figure against the product before publishing.

faq.q: Can I use the clip as a paid electronics ad?
faq.a: Yes. The watermark-free download can run in paid ads. Keep performance claims true to the device you ship.

faq.q: What video shape should I pick?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for a phone feed, 1:1 for a square, and 16:9 for a wide page. Use 4:3 or 3:4 when the page asks for them.

faq.q: Can the gadget ad include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Add a spoken line and captions, then review both before you download the clip.
